Mueller: 'no') — the density bands below are only an over-repetition smell test (flag above ~2%), never a quota to hit; place the keyphrase in title/H1/intro/one heading naturally instead. sectionLevel 3 matches the Neowin CMS (H3 section headers) — set it to 2 for a standard H2 site and all checks, suggestions and templates follow automatically.
